title: French-Style Yeast Fritters with Peas and Curry
description: Crispy fritters filled with a blend of peas, yeast, and curry, perfect for a snack or side dish. A delicious twist on traditional French cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast, flour, and salt.
2. Add water, eggs, and melted butter, mix until a smooth batter forms.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
5. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
6. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough into the hot oil.
7. Fry the fritters for about 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
8. Remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.
